question: The sum of the squares of two consecutive even natural numbers is 2180. The sum of the numbers is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For two consecutive even numbers, Sum of Squares = 2 × (Average² + 1)

⇒ Average² + 1 = 2180 ÷ 2 = 1090

⇒ Average² = 1089 ⇒ Average = 33

Sum of the two numbers = 2 × Average = 2 × 33 = 66

**∴ The correct answer is 66.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The sum of the squares of two consecutive even natural numbers is 2180.

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

**Calculations:**

Let the two consecutive even natural numbers be x and x + 2.

⇒ x² + (x + 2)² = 2180

⇒ x² + (x² + 4x + 4) = 2180

⇒ 2x² + 4x + 4 = 2180

⇒ 2x² + 4x − 2176 = 0

Dividing the equation by 2:

⇒ x² + 2x − 1088 = 0

⇒ x² + 34x − 32x − 1088 = 0

⇒ x(x + 34) − 32(x + 34) = 0

⇒ (x − 32)(x + 34) = 0

⇒ Roots are x = 32 and x = −34

⇒ Since the given values are natural numbers, x cannot be negative.

⇒ x = 32

⇒ The second consecutive even number is x + 2 = 34

⇒ Sum of the numbers = 32 + 34 = 66

**∴ The correct answer is 66.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Consecutive Even and Odd Numbers

The difference between any two consecutive even or odd numbers is always 2. If the first even/odd number is x, the next consecutive number will be x + 2.

Sum of First n Natural Numbers

The sum of the first n natural numbers is calculated using the formula S = n(n + 1) ÷ 2.

Sum of Squares of First n Natural Numbers

The sum of the squares of the first n natural numbers is determined by the formula S = n(n + 1)(2n + 1) ÷ 6.

Sum of First n Even Natural Numbers

The sum of the first n even natural numbers can be found directly using the formula S = n(n + 1).
